title: Camden Farmhouse
summary: A heritage farmhouse given a fresh, sunlit colour story — warm whites, natural brick and greenery throughout.
brief: This Camden farmhouse had character to spare — exposed brick, generous windows, and a garden that begged to be let inside. What it lacked was a colour scheme that tied its old and new halves together.
We developed a palette of warm whites and soft naturals, letting the brickwork and timber speak while bringing light deep into the plan.

photos.heading: The Dining Room
photos.text: Morning light across the brick feature wall. Pendant glassware was chosen to scatter rather than block the sun, keeping the room bright through the day.

photos.heading: The Kitchen
photos.text: Painted brick and butcher's-block timber keep the kitchen relaxed and practical — a working farmhouse kitchen, not a showpiece.

photos.heading: The Sitting Room
photos.text: The formal sitting room balances the home's heritage side: deeper tones, layered fabrics, and a quieter mood for evenings.
